categories.name: T-Watch S3 Plus · Voice and glance
categories.tagline: Keep the wrist interaction short and reliable.

ideas.title: Real-world caption acceptance
ideas.pitch: Test local English speech with the intended voice and noisy rooms.
ideas.experience: Captions appear promptly and a mistaken word can be corrected before Send.
ideas.how: Measure latency and accuracy on real PDM captures; select the model depth from evidence.
ideas.risks: Synthetic speech does not predict a child voice or outdoor noise.

ideas.title: Readable reply cards
ideas.pitch: Make a long answer easy to scan on 240×240.
ideas.experience: The watch shows a few lines at a time with clear next and replay actions.
ideas.how: Tune paging, touch targets and the shared response renderer.
ideas.risks: Small text and scrolling must pass readability testing.
ideas.audience: Watch users checking a reply quickly

ideas.title: Predictable call controls
ideas.pitch: Make Talk and Call hard to confuse.
ideas.experience: A hold starts listening; a clear tap or power action ends the session.
ideas.how: Validate BOOT, touch and POWER mappings with visible state and time limits.
ideas.risks: Accidental capture and interruption during sleep need physical tests.

ideas.title: A wrist-sized turn receipt
ideas.pitch: Show whether a spoken or typed turn was heard, sent and answered.
ideas.experience: A child can glance at a simple status instead of wondering whether to ask Levi again.
ideas.how: Render the durable turn state with the existing watch UI contract and preserve the retry ID through sleep.
ideas.risks: A timeout after acceptance must reconcile before a second send.
ideas.audience: Watch users in and out of Wi-Fi

ideas.title: Review before sending speech
ideas.pitch: Make misheard words easy to fix before they enter the family thread.
ideas.experience: The watch shows a short transcript with Confirm, Retry and Cancel as distinct touch actions.
ideas.how: Use the existing local speech draft path and bounded 240×240 text paging.
ideas.risks: Child voice and noisy-room accuracy need on-wrist tests.
ideas.audience: Children talking to Levi from the watch

categories.name: T-Watch S3 Plus · Power and nearby play
categories.tagline: Work in the background only when it pays off.

ideas.title: Measured battery budget
ideas.pitch: Show what listening, Wi-Fi and radio actually cost.
ideas.experience: The watch stays useful through the day and explains when a feature uses extra power.
ideas.how: Profile duty cycles on hardware, cap foreground work and sleep cleanly.
ideas.risks: Emulator and bench power numbers do not replace worn-battery tests.

ideas.title: Opt-in nearby game turn
ideas.pitch: Play one short turn with a Deck or tablet without Wi-Fi.
ideas.experience: A game invite is explicit, authenticated and times out after play.
ideas.how: Extend the existing peer contract with separate enrollment and app message receipts.
ideas.risks: The current bond is one-peer; new slots and disconnect recovery need firmware tests.

ideas.title: Quiet hours that respect sleep
ideas.pitch: Keep the wrist calm at night without losing the conversation.
ideas.experience: The watch stays dim and silent during family-set hours; the next glance shows waiting replies.
ideas.how: Store a small schedule locally, gate notifications and keep durable history on the service.
ideas.risks: Clock drift and emergency controls need a clear override.

ideas.title: Scout Trail in one glance
ideas.pitch: Let a tiny game turn fit the round trip to the wrist.
ideas.experience: Two large choices appear, then the story waits until the child asks for another turn.
ideas.how: Keep Scout Trail logic in shared Lua and render only the current choice on the watch canvas.
ideas.risks: Touch size and battery draw need a worn-device acceptance test.
